meta.name: circuit-breaker-pattern
meta.description: Implement circuit breaker patterns for fault tolerance, automatic failure detection, and fallback mechanisms. Use when calling external services, handling cascading failures, or implementing resilience patterns.

copy.tagline: 为外部服务调用添加熔断与降级保护
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在构建需要高可用的分布式系统或微服务
copy.tagline_en: Add circuit breaker and fallback protection for external service calls
copy.fit_line_en: For you if building distributed systems or microservices requiring high availability

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会实现断路器模式，用于监控外部服务调用。当检测到连续失败时，断路器会打开，停止后续请求并触发回退机制；一段时间后尝试恢复，成功则关闭断路器。
howto.when: 当需要调用外部服务、处理微服务通信、数据库连接等场景，或需要防止级联故障、实现回退机制时触发。

say.text: 帮我实现一个断路器，当API调用连续失败5次时打开，30秒后尝试恢复。
say.note: 设置失败阈值和重置超时。

say.text: 为我的微服务添加断路器，防止级联故障。
配置一个断路器，失败阈值为3，超时时间为2秒。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude implements the Circuit Breaker pattern to monitor external service calls. On consecutive failures, the circuit opens, halts requests, and triggers fallback; after a timeout, it attempts recovery and closes on success.
howto.when_en: Triggered when calling external services, handling microservices communication, database connections, or preventing cascading failures with fallback mechanisms.

say_en.text: Add a circuit breaker to my microservice to prevent cascading failures.
Configure a circuit breaker with failure threshold 3 and timeout 2 seconds.
say_en.note: Adjust parameters for the use case.
